text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Fu-chan, how about we get some lunch soon? 
You must be totally exhausted after 
cleaning and decorating all morning...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! But I'm okay. I'll just grab a 
quick bite for lunch, so let me keep 
going!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I have to finish it today, but... I don't 
want to cut corners either! This is the 
Tracen Academy Open Campus, after all—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of all the girls who will 
shine in the future. I want to welcome 
them with an ensemble full of hope!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trooper Machan has returned from errands.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Mewww~.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? What an adorable kitty! Wait, why 
is it here...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I borrowed it from the Chairwoman. When 
you are busy, you borrow any helping paw 
you can get.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: A helping... paw?

text_block_list.name: Cat-Loving Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Did I just hear a cat meow...?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~ Getting to fluff a kitty this much 
is pure bliss~.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... you're in the 
middle of decorating for the open campus, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A bond forged by cats. I shall assist. Let 
us finish this at Mach speed.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —I see, I see! All's well that ends well!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thanks to everyone, it was done in 
the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
V. In short, Operation Magnet Attraction 
was a great success.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Lure helpers with a kitty, go viral with 
cute two-shots, and Machan gets to pet the 
kitty. Killing three birds with one stone.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you so much for your great 
work, kitty♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman's Cat
text_block_list.text: Nya nya~~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today. You were a 
huge help!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're really amazing, Machan! Before I 
knew it, everyone had come over to help 
out.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If it were just me alone, I wouldn't have 
even thought of asking someone for help.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so quick to help because 
you've been working so hard, Flight-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
People notice when reliable types work 
hard. Including when they try to overexert 
themselves all alone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, it's completely okay to be a little 
sly once in a while, you know? Just like 
Machan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When things get tough, I should 
definitely learn to rely more on those 
around me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll be counting on you then! Professor 
Sly!

One day, while having lunch in the 
cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... The doll clothes that Flight-san 
made, no matter how many times I look, I 
fall in love with them all over again!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. It's thanks for the 
other day! It's the least I could do.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
After all, Machan, you're an irreplaceable 
roommate to me!
